subject: Fix reach-point delivery timing (GotoPost half of the noise/reach-point family)
description:
DONE at da65a5097 on wt-fix-noisetiming (branched from main bf8ceae96). Scope narrowed: the task bundled two sub-families on the guess that they shared one ordering root. They do not. The reach-point half is fixed here; the 11-trace heard-steps noise half is a genuinely different cause and is now task #39.

Root cause (b, DefaultGotoPost vs GotoPostTurn, 3 traces): `GetAnimation()` reads `mpOrder`, which the actor latches at Hourglass entry and only replaces on Proceed or Instruct. A condolence Think runs from inside the terminating element's callback, where that pointer still names the order that just finished. Five Think-dispatch sites instead recomputed the animation from a live `current_order_for_actor` lookup and fell back to `NonanimationEnd` whenever the element had no remaining orders — exactly the state a condolence Think observes. So `GoTo`'s close-point shortcut (gated on the actor being idle: WaitingUpright / WaitingAlerted / NonanimationEnd) fired for a soldier the Original still considered mid-Turn. Rust reported EventReachPoint from inside that same Think instead of launching a real Move whose first Execute lands the following frame, and the patrol substate ran a frame ahead. Confirmed directly: at the divergence frame the latched `installed_order` said `Turning` while the ctx the gate read said `NonanimationEnd`, and the Original's sprite rows (1503->1500) show it turning.

Fix: delete the five stale overrides. `installed_order` (added later, "Track Original actor mpOrder explicitly") is the faithful mpOrder mirror and `build_ai_context_from_entity` already derives `self_animation` from it, so the overrides only had to go. The16thFrame's periodic path keeps its explicitly threaded animation parameter and is deliberately untouched — flagged below.

Validation (debug): all 3 (b) traces advance past their old divergence — Nescafe/P001/Restart r014 f429->f499, Nescafe/P002/Restart r011 f462->f473, Nescafe/P003/Restart r014 f429->f499 (all now fail on unrelated actor.animation/command for other soldiers). 7 controls from the `pass` set unchanged. Unit tests: 92 failures before and after with identical failure sets, verified by reverting both files and re-running.

Watch item for the sweep: the periodic / The16thFrame path (engine/ai/mod.rs `tick_periodic_ai_for_npc_with_animation` and post_detection `tick_npc_post_detection_tail_for_npc`) still threads the live-read animation rather than `installed_order`. That is the same C++ `GetAnimation()` and is probably the same bug, but it feeds the bored-reroll gate that task #16 fixed, so it was left alone rather than changed without a repro.
